facts.value: Drinking is part of Irish culture, but traditionally, Irish pub culture was about much more than just pints. Pubs were (and still are) social hubs, much like cafés in other countries, where people gathered to catch up, unwind, and feel part of a community.
facts.programme_association: Irish Music - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: In rural parts of Ireland, the pub culture tradition endures.
facts.programme_association: Irish Music - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: The author visited a pub in Ballyferriter where it was just them, the barman, and three elderly men, each sitting apart, nursing a single pint for hours.
facts.programme_association: Irish Music - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: The barman indicated that the three elderly men lived alone, and the pub was their only human contact each day.
